001package com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.combat.dweller;
002
003import java.util.ArrayList;
004import java.util.List;
005
006import com.fs.starfarer.api.Global;
007import com.fs.starfarer.api.combat.CombatAssignmentType;
008import com.fs.starfarer.api.combat.CombatEngineAPI;
009import com.fs.starfarer.api.combat.CombatFleetManagerAPI;
010import com.fs.starfarer.api.combat.CombatFleetManagerAPI.AssignmentInfo;
011import com.fs.starfarer.api.combat.CombatTaskManagerAPI;
012import com.fs.starfarer.api.combat.DeployedFleetMemberAPI;
013import com.fs.starfarer.api.combat.ShipAPI;
014import com.fs.starfarer.api.combat.ShipwideAIFlags.AIFlags;
015import com.fs.starfarer.api.fleet.FleetGoal;
016import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.ids.HullMods;
017import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.ids.Tags;
018import com.fs.starfarer.api.util.IntervalUtil;
019
020/**
021 * Like the Threat one:
022 * Doesn't care about command points etc, just functions in a different way. May use command points/tasks/etc
023 * to accomplish its goals, just as an implementation detail, but conceptually it's fundamentally different from how
024 * human-type fleets work.
025 * 
026 * @author Alex
027 *
028 */
029public class DwellerCombatStrategyAI {
030        
031        protected boolean playerSide;
032        protected CombatTaskManagerAPI taskManager;
033        protected CombatFleetManagerAPI fleetManager;
034        protected CombatFleetManagerAPI enemyFleetManager;
035        protected int owner;
036        protected boolean allyMode = false;
037        
038        protected IntervalUtil everySecond = new IntervalUtil(0.8f, 1.2f);
039        protected CombatEngineAPI engine;
040        protected float mw, mh;
041        
042        protected boolean abort = false;
043        
044        protected AssignmentInfo mainDefend1;
045        protected AssignmentInfo mainDefend2;
046        
047        protected boolean gaveInitialOrders = false;
048        
049        
050        public DwellerCombatStrategyAI(int owner) {
051                engine = Global.getCombatEngine();
052                this.owner = owner;
053                playerSide = owner == 0;
054                allyMode = playerSide;
055                //allyMode = false;
056                fleetManager = engine.getFleetManager(owner);
057                taskManager = fleetManager.getTaskManager(allyMode);
058                taskManager.getCommandPointsStat().modifyFlat("DwellerCombatStrategyAI", 1000000000);
059                
060                enemyFleetManager = engine.getFleetManager(owner == 0 ? 1 : 0);
061                
062                if (fleetManager.getGoal() == FleetGoal.ESCAPE || enemyFleetManager.getGoal() == FleetGoal.ESCAPE) {
063                        abort = true;
064                }
065                
066                mw = engine.getMapWidth();
067                mh = engine.getMapHeight();
068        }
069        
070        protected void giveInitialOrders() {
071                if (fleetManager.getAdmiralAI() != null) {
072                        taskManager.clearTasks();
073                        fleetManager.getAdmiralAI().setNoOrders(true);
074                }       
075        }
076        
077        
078        public void advance(float amount) {
079                //if (true) return;
080                if (abort) return;
081                if (engine.isPaused()) return;
082                
083                everySecond.advance(amount);
084                if (everySecond.intervalElapsed()) {
085                        // if non-threat ships are deployed from this fleetManager, don't want to be doing any Threat things
086                        List<DeployedFleetMemberAPI> deployed = fleetManager.getDeployedCopyDFM();
087                        if (deployed.isEmpty()) return;
088                        
089                        boolean someMatching = false;
090                        for (DeployedFleetMemberAPI member : deployed) {
091                                if (!member.isFighterWing() && member.getShip() != null &&
092                                                member.isAlly() == allyMode &&
093                                                !member.getShip().getVariant().hasHullMod(HullMods.DWELLER_HULLMOD)) {
094                                        abort = true;
095                                        return;
096                                } else if (!member.isFighterWing() && member.getShip() != null &&
097                                                member.isAlly() == allyMode) {
098                                        someMatching = true;
099                                }
100                        }
101                        
102                        if (!someMatching) return;
103                        
104                        if (!gaveInitialOrders) {
105                                giveInitialOrders();
106                                gaveInitialOrders = true;
107                        }
108                        
109                        boolean hasMaw = false;
110                        for (DeployedFleetMemberAPI member : fleetManager.getDeployedCopyDFM()) {
111                                ShipAPI ship = member.getShip();
112                                if (ship == null || ship.getAI() == null) continue;
113                                
114                                if (isMaw(ship)) {
115                                        hasMaw = true;
116                                        AssignmentInfo curr = taskManager.getAssignmentInfoForTarget(member);
117                                        if (curr == null) {
118                                                taskManager.createAssignment(CombatAssignmentType.DEFEND, member, false);
119                                                taskManager.orderSearchAndDestroy(member, false);
120                                        }
121                                } else if (isEye(ship)) {
122                                        AssignmentInfo curr = taskManager.getAssignmentInfoForTarget(member);
123                                        if (curr == null) {
124                                                taskManager.createAssignment(CombatAssignmentType.HEAVY_ESCORT, member, false);
125                                                taskManager.orderSearchAndDestroy(member, false);
126                                        }
127                                } else if (isStinger(ship)) {
128//                                      AssignmentInfo curr = taskManager.getAssignmentInfoForTarget(member);
129//                                      if (curr == null) {
130//                                              taskManager.createAssignment(CombatAssignmentType.HEAVY_ESCORT, member, false);
131//                                              taskManager.orderSearchAndDestroy(member, false);
132//                                      }
133                                }
134                        }
135                        
136                        if (!hasMaw) {
137                                taskManager.orderSearchAndDestroy();
138                                for (DeployedFleetMemberAPI member : fleetManager.getDeployedCopyDFM()) {
139                                        ShipAPI ship = member.getShip();
140                                        if (ship == null || ship.getAI() == null || ship.getAIFlags() == null) continue;
141                                        ship.getAIFlags().setFlag(AIFlags.DO_NOT_BACK_OFF, 2f);
142                                        ship.getAIFlags().setFlag(AIFlags.DO_NOT_BACK_OFF_EVEN_WHILE_VENTING, 2f);
143                                }
144                        }
145                        
146                        cleanUpEmptyAssignments();
147                }
148        }
149        
150        
151        protected void cancelOrders(DeployedFleetMemberAPI member, boolean withSearchAndDestroy) {
152                AssignmentInfo curr = taskManager.getAssignmentFor(member.getShip());
153                if (curr != null) {
154                        taskManager.removeAssignment(curr);
155                }
156                if (withSearchAndDestroy) {
157                        taskManager.orderSearchAndDestroy(member, false);
158                }
159        }
160        
161        public void cleanUpEmptyAssignments() {
162                taskManager.reassign(); // so assigned members isn't empty
163                List<AssignmentInfo> remove = new ArrayList<>();
164                for (AssignmentInfo curr : taskManager.getAllAssignments()) {
165                        if (curr.getType() == CombatAssignmentType.CONTROL) continue;
166                        if (curr.getType() == CombatAssignmentType.CAPTURE) continue;
167                        if (curr.getType() == CombatAssignmentType.DEFEND) continue;
168                        if (curr.getAssignedMembers().isEmpty()) {
169                                remove.add(curr);
170                        }
171                }
172                for (AssignmentInfo curr : remove) {
173                        taskManager.removeAssignment(curr);
174                }
175                
176                taskManager.clearEmptyWaypoints();
177        }
178        
179        
180        public static boolean isMaw(ShipAPI ship) {
181                boolean isMaw = ship != null && ship.isCapital();
182                return isMaw;
183        }
184        public static boolean isEye(ShipAPI ship) {
185                boolean isEye = ship != null && ship.isCruiser() && ship.getHullSpec().hasTag(Tags.DWELLER_RECKLESS);
186                return isEye;
187        }
188        public static boolean isStinger(ShipAPI ship) {
189                boolean isEye = ship != null && ship.isCruiser() && ship.getHullSpec().hasTag(Tags.DWELLER_TIMID);
190                return isEye;
191        }
192        public static boolean isTendril(ShipAPI ship) {
193                boolean isTendril = ship != null && ship.isDestroyer();
194                return isTendril;
195        }
196}
